purpose: Track concrete APIs selected after independent reference feature coverage reached39/39.
referencePolicy: Probably Stolen skill is reference; current game signatures and official public APIs decide implementation. No Forge implementation copied.

selected.problemZh: 内容Mod反复接触原生升级/服务对象，容易把已介绍、已解锁、实际生效或付款混为一谈。
selected.problemEn: Mods otherwise repeat native progression lookups and confuse introduced, unlocked, active and paid states.
selected.behavior: Current-run managed snapshots from exact native predicates; no purchase/unlock/cost update.

selected.problemZh: 机器、对话、工坊和事件各写一套前置判断，未知状态取反会错误放行，JSON和C#规则也容易不一致。
selected.problemEn: Machines, dialogue, workshops and events duplicate gates; negating unknown facts can incorrectly allow actions.
selected.behavior: Shared strict C#/JSON bounded condition tree and three-valued evaluation; typed bilingual reasons; actual current-run fact adapter.

selected.problemZh: 每个物品升级Mod重复处理标签、损坏JSON、版本迁移和交易冻结。
selected.problemEn: Item upgrades otherwise duplicate tag ownership, malformed JSON, migration and freeze checks.
selected.behavior: Official versioned item JSON; compare revision, bounded data, native freeze and readback checks; no auto-save. Historical0.1.72 scoped fixture save/restoration does not establish current-DLL native acceptance.

selected.problemZh: 实战订货系统需要原版和其他Mod全物品货池，现有ItemApi快照仅覆盖EZapi声明，重复编写全目录枚举、分帧创建、销毁和语言缓存逻辑。
selected.problemEn: A real ordering Mod needs all native/other-Mod stock, but ItemApi snapshots only list EZapi declarations; directory enumeration, batched creation, cleanup and locale invalidation were duplicated.
selected.behavior: Native complete ID capture and explicit main-thread metadata scan, no silent truncation; per-item failures, detached cleanup and run/locale invalidation.

selected.problemZh: 实战订货重复初始化普通货物/赃物、覆盖已有赃物热度并核对结果。
selected.problemEn: Delivery consumers repeat native origin initialization, correction of already-stolen heat and readback.
selected.behavior: Explicit native clean/fixed heat/default initialization with snapshot and guarded readback. No save or delivery.

selected.problemZh: 实战选货重复读取图集裁切，黑图/全透明图、不可读纹理和清理边界容易误判。
selected.problemEn: Real stock selection duplicates atlas crops, transparency/content tests, unreadable GPU readback and cleanup.
selected.behavior: Native raw Sprite inspection plus pure RGBA counts, UV masks, split alpha and explicit failure outcomes; no sale rules.

selected.problemZh: 实战订单和礼包重复实现凭据与库存对账；原生交付可能销毁旧包装对象，未找到凭据不能直接补发。
selected.problemEn: Orders and starter kits duplicate token/reconciliation logic; native handoff may destroy the old wrapper and absence must not authorize reissue.
selected.behavior: Official detached item-data stamps; two fresh bounded scans; exact managed handoff and stable-operation recovery; caller ledger/save/payment/native admission remain explicit.

selected.problemZh: 实战订货将普通目录空箱模板当完整货物，另写物资填充、锁恢复和原地修复，随机模块/真品工厂也重复路由。
selected.problemEn: Orders confuse empty directory templates with filled native crates, duplicate prepared module/injector routes and later need legacy repair.
selected.behavior: Explicit12 native factories; preserve contents/RNG policy; bounded isolated graph checks, runtime crate lock and root ownership/readback; no automatic repair or delivery.

selected.problemZh: 装满子物品的物资箱会新增多个实例，单件凭据差额不足以确认完整交付。
selected.problemEn: A populated crate adds several instances, exceeding single-item receipt delta semantics.
selected.behavior: Bounded complete graph captures, exact same-load graph delta and explicit child ownership initialization policy; root-only receipt recovery after load.
